title: Higgs / Quantum Tuber / Potato Excitations — Developed BSM Theory
status: Great Book field archaeology + developed BSM model family; no historical Tim-boson particle established
abstract: The Quantum Tuber branch becomes scientifically meaningful when 'first ripple in Infinite Soil' is translated into a concrete excitation problem: choose a field and vacuum, derive the small fluctuations around that vacuum, determine whether localized nonlinear configurations exist, and ask whether any resulting state has measurable consequences distinct from familiar Higgs-portal or dark-U(1) models. This redevelopment makes the branch calculational. The real-singlet fork is developed through its phase structure, stationarity equations, scalar mass matrix, mixing, couplings and decay logic. The complex-U(1)_P fork adds a gauge boson, kinetic mixing and symmetry-breaking spectrum. 'Quantum Tuber' is then treated as a classification label for one of four possible objects—particle excitation, wavepacket, phase-transition bubble or topological/non-topological localized configuration—whose existence must be demonstrated by the chosen equations rather than inferred from the name. A novel Potato-sector claim survives only if it predicts something beyond a generic singlet or dark-photon-style extension. The branch is T2: it now contains a coherent field-theory workflow and worked formulas, but no unique historical representation or parameter region has been established.
research_question: Which minimal Potato-sector completion admits a stable vacuum and a mathematically identifiable Quantum-Tuber excitation, and can that excitation be distinguished experimentally from ordinary scalar-singlet or Abelian hidden-sector physics?

standard_higgs_baseline.meaning: The observed Higgs is the physical fluctuation about the electroweak vacuum. The Potato-sector question is whether an additional fluctuation exists and how it couples to h.

fork_A_real_singlet.potential: V=-mu_H^2 H^dagger H+lambda_H(H^dagger H)^2+mu_P^2 P^2/2+lambda_P P^4/4+lambda_HP P^2 H^dagger H/2

phases.unbroken_Z2: v_P=0; no tree-level h-P mixing; P can be stable if no odd operators are present
phases.mixed_phase: v_P not equal 0; h and s mix and both mass eigenstates inherit couplings to the Standard Model

stationarity_mixed_phase: -mu_P^2=lambda_P v_P^2+(lambda_HP/2)v^2 if the sign convention yields symmetry breaking in P
fork_A_real_singlet.mass_matrix: M^2=[[2lambda_H v^2,lambda_HP v v_P],[lambda_HP v v_P,2lambda_P v_P^2]]
fork_A_real_singlet.coupling_rule: Standard-Model-like couplings of h1/h2 are rescaled by the corresponding Higgs-component cosine/sine factors.
fork_A_real_singlet.boundedness: lambda_H>0, lambda_P>0, lambda_HP>-2sqrt(lambda_H lambda_P) at tree level in this normalization

fork_B_complex_U1.field: complex Phi_P of charge q_P under U(1)_P
fork_B_complex_U1.radial_mass: m_s^2 approximately 2lambda_P v_P^2 before Higgs mixing in the simple quartic model
fork_B_complex_U1.kinetic_mixing_meaning: epsilon transfers a small coupling to hypercharge/electromagnetic currents after diagonalization; it is a principal observable interface unless forbidden.
fork_B_complex_U1.anomaly_rule: Any chiral fermions charged under U(1)_P require gauge and mixed anomaly cancellation.

particle.definition: normal-mode quantum around a stable vacuum
particle.equation: Gamma^(2)(p)delta P(p)=0; poles of the propagator define masses
particle.existence_test: positive physical pole/residue in the stated EFT regime

wavepacket.equation: P(x,t)=integral d3p a(p) exp[i(p.x-E_p t)] plus conjugate terms

bubble.definition: localized region of another phase during a first-order transition
bubble.equation: phi''+(3/rho)phi'=dV_eff/dphi for an O(4)-symmetric Euclidean bounce comparator
bubble.existence_test: multiple metastable minima and a finite-action bounce

soliton_or_defect.existence_test: requires appropriate topology, conserved charge or nonlinear balance; Derrick-type scaling constraints must be checked
soliton_or_defect.boundary: a generic real scalar in 3+1D does not automatically support a stable static lump

thermal_phase_transition_extension.motivation: The historical language of activation/emergence naturally suggests asking whether the Potato sector undergoes an actual phase transition.
thermal_phase_transition_extension.critical_temperature: T_c is defined by degenerate relevant minima, not by symbolism
observable_interfaces: possible gravitational-wave background for a sufficiently strong first-order transition
changed relic abundance or symmetry history
thermal_phase_transition_extension.promotion_gate: compute a consistent finite-temperature effective potential and nucleation action before invoking cosmological transition signatures

decay_and_production_logic.mixing_case: A mixed scalar inherits Standard-Model production and decay channels multiplied approximately by its Higgs-component squared, plus any new Potato-sector channels.
decay_and_production_logic.invisible_case: If an exact-Z2 P is lighter than m_h/2, h->PP can occur with width determined by lambda_HP and phase space.
decay_and_production_logic.vector_case: A kinetically mixed A_P can be produced or decay through its induced couplings depending on mass and epsilon.
decay_and_production_logic.novelty_rule: Calling a resonance a Quantum Tuber adds no scientific content unless the Potato model predicts its mass/coupling pattern or solution structure.

failure_conditions: No acceptable vacuum or the desired vacuum is unstable in the claimed parameter region.
A claimed localized Quantum Tuber is not a solution of the completed equations.
Experimental constraints remove the proposed parameter region.
The theory has no prediction beyond a generic singlet/U(1) model.
